question.problem: Lewis spends $0.5$ hours per day studying. How many minutes per week does Lewis study for?
question.worked_solution:
We are given the units $\frac{\text{hours}}{\text{day}},$ and we want to convert this into $\frac{\text{min}}{\text{week}}.$ We're converting two units instead of just one, so we're going to have to multiply by two conversion factors:

$$
\frac{\text{hours}}{\text{day}}\cdot \,\frac{?}{?}\cdot \,\frac{?}{?}=\frac{\text{min}}{\text{week}}
$$

One of the conversion factors should change $\text{hours}$ to $\text{min}.$

$$
\frac{\cancel{\text{hours}}}{\text{day}}\cdot \frac{\text{min}}{\cancel{\text{hour}}}\cdot \,\frac{?}{?}=\frac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}
$$

The other conversion factor should change $\text{day}$ into $\text{week}.$

$$
\frac{\cancel{\text{hours}}}{\cancel{\text{day}}}\cdot \frac{\text{min}}{\cancel{\text{hour}}}\cdot \frac{\cancel{\text{days}}}{\text{week}}=\frac{\text{min}}{\text{week}}
$$

So, our conversion formula is

$$
\frac{\text{hours}}{\text{day}}\cdot \frac{\text{min}}{\text{hour}}\cdot \frac{\text{days}}{\text{week}}=\frac{\text{min}}{\text{week}}.
$$

Now that we have our conversion formula, we need to determine the correct numbers to use, and apply it.

- The rate given in the problem statement is $0.5\,\frac{\text{hours}}{\text{day}}.$

- There are $60$ minutes per hour.

- There are $7$ days per week.

Applying our conversion formula, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}0.5\,\frac{\text{hours}}{\text{day}} & =0.5\,\frac{\text{hours}}{\text{day}}\cdot 60\,\frac{\text{min}}{\text{hour}}\cdot 7\,\frac{\text{days}}{\text{week}} \\  & =(0.5\cdot 60\cdot 7)\,\frac{\cancel{\text{hours}}}{\cancel{\text{day}}}\cdot \frac{\text{min}}{\cancel{\text{hour}}}\cdot \frac{\cancel{\text{days}}}{\text{week}} \\  & =210\,\frac{\text{min}}{\text{week}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, Lewis studies at a rate of $210\,\text{min/week}.$
